content:
oliver: Quick thought — our postmortem follow-ups are drifting. proposing a lightweight 'owner -> due -> verification' matrix + a 3-step closure cadence. attaching sketch below, feedback?

maya_oncall: +1, we've seen action items linger. can we auto-create tasks for anything >2w?

oliver: yes, idea: after postmortem publish, generate tickets for each action in the 'Remediation' section. template:
```text
Action: Reduce cold-starts for model X
Owner: @sam_engineering
Due: 2025-05-01
Verification: perf regression test + canary
Status: open
```

sam_engineering: i can take cold-starts. need ~3 sprints. can set due: 2025-05-15

lina_sre: suggest adding 'severity impact' and 'recurrence tag' so we can prioritize recurring incidents.

harpreet_pm: recommended comms cadence: postmortem D+3 owner updates, D+14 progress check, D+30 verification + close. any objections?

maya_oncall: D+3 is tight but ok. prefer automated reminders from inc-bot.

inc-bot: Reminder set — D+3, D+14, D+30 notifications will be posted in #eng-oncall and to assignees.

sam_engineering: one question: who approves closure? propose 'sre owner + original IC'

oliver: agree — closure requires sign-off by the IC + SRE owner. i'll add to template.

lina_sre: also add a 'rollback mitigation' field for infra changes.

harpreet_pm: i'll update the template and run it by ops leads tmrw.

oliver: awesome. next steps: harpreet to publish updated template, maya to wire inc-bot task creation, sam to add initial schedule to JIRA, lina to add recurrence tags. check back in one week? :calendar:

maya_oncall: sounds good. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
